# forwardemail_alias_smtp_credentials (Resource)

A resource to generate SMTP credentials for a Forward Email alias. This allows the alias to send outbound email via SMTP.

~> **Warning:** Using `is_override = true` will permanently delete existing IMAP storage and reset the alias' SQLite email database. Use with caution.

## Example usage

```hcl
resource "forwardemail_alias_smtp_credentials" "tony" {
  domain      = "stark.com"
  alias       = "tony"
  is_override = true
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) Alias name.
- `domain` (String) Fully qualified domain name (FQDN).

### Optional

- `emailed_instructions` (String) Email address to send password and setup instructions to.
- `is_override` (Boolean) Override existing password. WARNING: This permanently deletes existing IMAP storage and resets the alias' SQLite email database.
- `new_password` (String, Sensitive) Custom password for the alias. Leave blank for a randomly generated strong password.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The generated SMTP password. Only available if emailed_instructions is not set.
- `username` (String) The SMTP username (email address).
